title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer


We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, PySpark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure DevOps.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and optimize ETL ELT pipelines using Databricks, PySpark to ingest, transform and serve data for digital customer experience.
  • Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption.
  • Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration, performance tuning and cost awareness.
  • Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries.
  • Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across GitHub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation, checks monitoring and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys.
  • For Senior Developer lead module level design, mentor engineers drive standards for CI/CD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines.


Requirements

  • Strong handson experience with: Python, PySpark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization.
  • Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, GitHub and/or Bitbucket.
  • Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads.
  • Strong working experience with Azure DevOps, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows.
  • English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners.


If this sounds like the next challenge for you, apply now with an updated resume in English and we'll take it from here :)

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

The Demand Generation Manager is responsible for ensuring that clients receive high-quality marketing execution that drives measurable results. Whether through points our hours, this role ensures work is delivered efficiently and transparently based on each client’s contract.

This role requires strong strategic thinking, project management, and client relationship skills to ensure marketing initiatives are effectively planned, executed, and optimized. You will act as the primary contact for clients, overseeing campaign execution, aligning resources, and ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.

As an Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for translating client goals into actionable deliverables , managing project priorities, and ensuring each initiative aligns with their business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:Client Strategy & Execution

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment on objectives.

● Guide quarterly strategy calls , translating business goals into structured marketing initiatives.

● Define and prioritize client deliverables , ensuring efficient execution.

● Proactively provide strategic insights and recommendations to enhance marketing performance.

Project & Resource Management

● Oversee the execution of marketing campaigns , coordinating with Specialists to achieve desired results.

● Monitor progress on deliverables , ensuring projects stay within the allocated scope.

● Manage deadlines, approvals, and revisions , ensuring seamless project completion.

● Work with internal teams to optimize workflows and improve efficiency in marketing execution.

Performance & Optimization

● Track and analyze marketing performance , identifying areas for optimization.

● Collaborate with channel heads and Account Directors to ensure high quality deliverables get produced and contribute to client goals.

● Regularly review client satisfaction and engagement , proactively addressing potential issues.

● Identify opportunities for upselling additional services that align with client needs.

● Collaborate with the Growth Manager to ensure high client retention and continued success.

Success Metrics

In this role, you’ll be accountable for the following key performance indicators:

● Client point burden , ensuring each client remains on track based on the amount of points/hours purchased.

● Client goals, ensuring we are hitting the pre-defined targets set forth to define specific outcomes from the engagement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in-house in B2B digital marketing or demand generation, ideally within software and technology.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid media channels and optimizing digital performance.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics, digital attribution models, and revenue-oriented KPIs.
  • Excellent project management skills; capable of managing internal projects and multiple external vendors.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a solid grasp of attribution models and proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, DreamData, or similar.
  • Familiarity with technical tools like Google Tag Manager, and Optimizely or VWO.
  • The ability to self-direct and self-start and work independently as well as within and across teams.
  • Hands-on experience in using marketing automation technology (HubSpot) and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • C1 or C2 English proficiency level.
  • CV and LinkedIn profile in English showcasing experience in chronological order.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Prior experience in a growth-stage or scale-up SaaS business.
  • Familiarity with content personalization, dynamic content, or account-based web experiences.
  • Experience with SQL or business intelligence tools (e.g., Domo, Looker, Tableau, etc.).

We are looking for contractor support to strengthen creative workflow operations. This person would not be focused on creative production itself, but on helping requests move efficiently through intake, scoping, setup, and handoff, while also supporting workflow improvements in Asana .

  • Intake flow and request readiness: Review, organize, and prepare incoming requests after triage so work can move to the next step efficiently. Help reduce the backlog of post-triage tickets and structure requests that have been triaged but still need scoping before assignment or execution.

  • Work-in-progress visibility and reporting: Support tracking and reporting on outstanding requests, bottlenecks, and workflow needs — giving the team a clearer, more reliable view of what's in flight.
  • Scalable workflow support structure: Help establish a support model that can grow with the team as request volume increases and as creative and content operations become more closely integrated.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience (+5 years);
  • Fluent in English ;
  • Experience in operational workflow management, ideally within creative or content teams;
  • Strong command of Asana — including task creation, rules, reports, and automations;
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational instincts;

  • Clear communicator with a track record of clean, context-rich handoffs;

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)


We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.


Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.


In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting
  • Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development
  • Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis
  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster
  • Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbers


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial
  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling
  • AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how
  • Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models
  • You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send
  • Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holding


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature
  • Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similar


ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Analytics Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what’s hot, what’s not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.

● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who is:

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the “why” behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

Bonus if you have:

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.


What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

● Annual Meitu products membership

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.


Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability


O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição


  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.


Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

title: Desenvolvedor de software em teste
description:
Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium and Playwright for mobile and API layers
  • Build and execute test cases mapped to JIRA user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Conduct functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing across Android and iOS
  • File and manage defects in JIRA, providing detailed reproduction steps and severity assessment
  • Support parallel test execution and help triage automation results from CI/CD runs
  • Work alongside Mobile developers in a collaborative, shift-left testing approach
  • Maintain and improve test data management strategies for consistent test execution
  • Provide QA sign-off on user stories prior to sprint completion
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement discussions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 5+ years of QA automation or SDET experience
  • Proficiency with Selenium WebDriver and Playwright
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript
  • Experience with mobile automation using Appium and/or native testing frameworks
  • Proven use of JIRA for test management, defect tracking, and sprint participation
  • Familiarity with CI/CD integration for automated test suites
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work on multiple test workstreams simultaneously
  • Solid understanding of software QA methodologies and Agile practices
  • Working knowledge of Test Driven Development (TDD) principles and experience contributing to TDD-based workflows
  • Experience with parallel test execution strategies and grid-based testing (Selenium Grid)
  • Background in performance or load testing for mobile backends
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and pull-request-based QA review workflows


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Position Overview:

As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‑generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‑first operations, and AI‑driven decision‑making across the organization.


You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.


Responsibilities:

  • Administers day‑to‑day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance.
  • Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams.
  • Partners with cross‑functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows.
  • Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements.
  • Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health.
  • Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‑powered workflow automations.
  • Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‑channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations.
  • Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience.
  • Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling.
  • Ensures secure, least‑privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs.
  • Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment.
  • Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement.
  • Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools.
  • Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‑scaling teams.
  • Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‑to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance.


Position Requirements:

  • 4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‑level or high‑velocity environment.
  • Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred.
  • Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel.


Additional Requirements:

  • Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.
  • Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred).
  • Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
  • Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‑functional GTM operations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
  • Hands‑on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment.

title: Salesforce CRM Specialist
description:
Position Overview:

As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate.

This role sits within the Marketing team, working alongside peers across demand generation, digital performance, brand, and content.


Key Responsibilities:


Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC):

Support the execution and optimization of campaigns within SFMC. Collaborate on building, testing, and deploying journeys and automations with a strong focus on the end-user experience and business impact.

Client Journey:

Assist in building and improving omnichannel journeys across email and SMS, supporting key moments from lead to booking to post-visit engagement, including reminders and follow-ups.

Data Segmentation and Hygiene:

Maintain audience segments and support data quality initiatives, including contact organization, suppression lists, and basic scoring logic to ensure a reliable database.

Testing & Quality Control:

Execute A/B tests on subject lines, send times, messaging, and journey logic. Document results and apply learnings to improve performance.

Performance & Reporting:

Support CRM reporting by tracking key metrics such as bookings, conversion rates, and engagement. Contribute to performance analysis and insights.

Operational Support:

Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey.

Platform Integrations:

Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed.


Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation roles, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud



Preferred Qualifications:

Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification

Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM

Experience in multi-location services, retail, or health and wellness industries

Familiarity with booking or practice management systems

Experience with SMS marketing and omnichannel engagement

Basic understanding of Martech integrations and data structures

Experience creating or adapting content to improve engagement across the client lifecycle

This role is for the person who:

  • Wants to help founders of eCommerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
  • Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
  • Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged.


The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.

To support our continued growth, this is an active position we’re currently recruiting for.


About UpCounting

We’re a fully remote, tech-powered firm helping eCommerce and digital-first businesse s scale with confidence.

Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Pleno
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de tecnologia e inteligência de dados da América Latina, com 15 anos de mercado, mais de 200 pessoas e presença consolidada no ecossistema de comunicação, marketing e inteligência de mercado. Desenvolvemos soluções de tecnologia que empoderam marcas, de assessorias de imprensa e agências de relações públicas a grandes empresas e governos.

Somos uma empresa em forte expansão, com três rodadas de capital de risco realizadas (Oria Capital), cultura ágil e um time que acredita que tecnologia e pessoas transformam negócios de verdade.


Estamos buscando um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas para atuar no segmento Mid Market e Enterprise , com perfil híbrido : capaz de fechar novos negócios com leads gerados pelo Marketing, desenvolver prospecção ativa (outbound) e explorar oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes existente.

Essa é uma vaga para quem tem mentalidade de crescimento, visão de negócio e sabe construir relações consultivas com decisores de comunicação e marketing em empresas de médio e grande porte.

Vaga 100% remota - Home Office


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar no ciclo completo de vendas: da qualificação ao fechamento, com contas Mid Market e Enterprise;
  • Trabalhar leads qualificados gerados pelo Marketing (inbound), com foco em conversão eficiente;

  • Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes atual, em parceria com o time de Customer Success;

  • Construir e manter relacionamento sólido com múltiplos stakeholders (comunicação, marketing, C-level);
  • Mapear o processo decisório do cliente e influenciar cada etapa do funil;
  • Manter o CRM (HubSpot) atualizado com precisão e disciplina, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas e conduzir negociações complexas;
  • Colaborar ativamente com Marketing, CS e RevOps para otimizar conversão e reduzir churn.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B SaaS, com ciclos de venda consultivos e tickets médios/altos;
  • Experiência com contas Mid Market ou Enterprise;
  • Histórico de atuação híbrida: capacidade tanto de converter inbound quanto de gerar pipeline outbound;

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade real de se comunicar com decisores;

Também é legal se você tiver:

  • Vivência em ambientes de scale-up e/ou startups em crescimento acelerado ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Familiaridade com HubSpot.
  • Carteira ou relacionamento com profissionais de Comunicação e Marketing em empresas de médio/grande porte;

O que oferecemos:

  • Política de remuneração variável agressiva - com comissionamento competitivo e upside real atrelado à sua performance;
  • Pacote de benefícios Knewin;
  • Produto consolidado com cases relevantes no mercado;
  • Time comercial estruturado com suporte de Marketing, RevOps e CS;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, flexível e com autonomia real;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em fase de expansão acelerada.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems.
  • Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents.
  • Work directly with customers and their IT teams to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure solutions.
  • Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks.
  • Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents.
  • Exercise sound technical judgment when diagnosing and resolving infrastructure issues that may not have predefined solutions.
  • Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation.
  • Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks.
  • Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems.
  • Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines.



Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment.
  • Experience with Windows or Linux server administration.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).
  • Cloud platform administration experience; Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting.
  • Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Full Stack Web Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta oportunidade irá atender um de nossos clientes globais do segmento de óleo e gás, com atuação em projetos estratégicos e de grande escala, em um ambiente altamente tecnológico e com interação internacional.

Oportunidade para atuar com desenvolvimento Full Stack em aplicações modernas, envolvendo arquitetura escalável, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web e atuação em ambientes cloud.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web full stack (frontend e backend)
  • Construir e consumir APIs REST utilizando .NET (C#)
  • Desenvolver interfaces responsivas com Angular e/ou Vue.js
  • Atuar com deploy e gestão de aplicações em cloud (Azure e/ou AWS)
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD e versionamento com Git
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento (clean code, testes, design patterns)
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em ambiente ágil

Dependendo do projeto, você também poderá atuar com:

  • Integração de APIs
  • Containerização com Docker
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform)



O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência como Full Stack Web Developer em ambiente produtivo
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em C# e .NET (APIs REST)
  • Experiência com Angular (TypeScript) e/ou Vue.js / AngularJS
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure ou AWS)
  • Vivência com Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Conhecimentos em HTML, CSS e JavaScript
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com times globais



Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com arquitetura de sistemas escaláveis
  • Vivência com CI/CD (build, testes e deploy)
  • Experiência com Docker (containerização)
  • Conhecimento em Terraform ou outras ferramentas de IaC
  • Experiência com manutenção e evolução de aplicações


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Desenvolvedor Front-end Pleno (Next.js + React)
description:

  • Experiência prática com Next.js
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de Zustand ou Redux Toolkit
  • SASS/SCSS avançado
  • Integração sólida com APIs REST

title: Endpoint System Engineer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Endpoint System Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Endpoint Systems Engineer is responsible for managing and supporting endpoint platforms and tooling across customer environments within the Managed Services organization. This role focuses on endpoint management, patching, monitoring, and automation using centralized management tools. Endpoint Systems Engineers ensure endpoint health, compliance, and performance through proactive monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of tooling and processes.This role combines technical troubleshooting with platform ownership and automation, working closely with internal teams and customer stakeholders to maintain stable, secure, and well-managed endpoint environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Own the health, performance, and compliance of endpoint environments across customer environments.
  • Manage and maintain endpoint management platforms (MDM/RMM), including Intune and NinjaOne.
  • Monitor and maintain endpoint health, patching, and compliance, ensuring successful deployment and remediation of OS and application updates.
  • Investigate and resolve endpoint-related issues, including performance, configuration, and policy enforcement problems.
  • Create and manage problem investigations for recurring or complex endpoint issues.
  • Develop, test, and maintain scripts and automation (PowerShell preferred) to support endpoint management and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain integrations between endpoint management tools and other systems (e.g., ITSM, monitoring platforms).
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and support teams to resolve cross-system issues impacting endpoints.
  • Maintain endpoint configuration standards, policies, and documentation.
  • Participate in change management processes for endpoint-related updates and deployments.
  • Identify and implement improvements to endpoint management, automation, and operational processes.


Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting endpoint management in an MSP, enterprise IT, or similar environment.
  • Experience with endpoint management platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, other MDM solutions).
  • Experience with RMM tools (e.g., NinjaOne or similar platforms).
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID device management.
  • Experience with Windows endpoint administration and lifecycle management.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills related to endpoint systems.
  • Experience with patch management processes and tools.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and structured support processes.
  • Strong scripting skills (PowerShell preferred) for automation and tooling.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Certifications such as Microsoft, endpoint management, or cloud certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Deep experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies, including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Senior Digital Analytics Engineer
description:
Company Description

In 1995, Acronym created a digital marketing revolution by innovating a futuristic model of the marketing agency. Since then, we’ve forged a lasting path of success helping our Clients achieve their business goals.

Acronym. Our name signifies our deep understanding of both our Clients’ and industries lexicon.
