title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Finance manager
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities
Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.
Requirements Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution. Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations. Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus. Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends
Education & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships
Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors
Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)
Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment
Equal Opportunity Employer
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.
How to Apply
Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Cloud operations engineer
description:
About Eightpoint
Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.
About the Role
The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the Dev Ops team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the Dev Ops and Systems Administration teams.
Key Responsibilities

Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
Support GCP workloads, primarily Big Query pipelines and related data infrastructure.
Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; Cloud Watch; One Uptime).
Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.
Who You Are

5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role.
Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front).
Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions.
Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services.
Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Sys Ops, or Dev Ops Engineer).
Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.

- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;

description:
Sobre nós

A Evolucional acredita que o uso de dados pode transformar a educação e o processo de aprendizagem. Atuamos, desde 2014, oferecendo simulados e avaliações para escolas em todo o Brasil. A partir disso, geramos dados precisos sobre o conhecimento dos alunos, e ajudamos as instituições de ensino na transformação da gestão pedagógica.

  • Diagramar provas, simulados e materiais avaliativos conforme identidade visual da instituição.

  • Preparar arquivos finais para impressão e/ou publicação digital.
  • Realizar ajustes finos em textos, tabelas, imagens e fórmulas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com revisores, designers e autores nos processos de preparação dos instrumentos.
  • Manter e atualizar templates e guias de diagramação.
  • Otimizar processos gráficos visando agilidade e qualidade nas entregas.

O que é preciso para darmos #match

  • Experiência em diagramação editorial, preferencialmente de provas, livros didáticos ou materiais educacionais.
  • Domínio de Adobe InDesign (essencial) e conhecimento de Illustrator, Photoshop e Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento de normas gráficas e boas práticas de editoração.
  • Atenção aos detalhes, senso estético e excelente organização.
  • Capacidade de lidar com prazos curtos e alto volume de materiais.

Aqui, você vai encontrar um espaço acolhedor, que irá dar oportunidade para que você aprenda e se desenvolva! Fazemos isso por meio de um trabalho em equipe harmonioso, que conta com pessoas qualificadas e abertas a ensinar e aprender, buscando sempre obter os melhores resultados para o time!

title: Mid-Level Quality Assurance (QA)
description:
Please note that this role works 100% on-site.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-Level QA professional to work collaboratively within agile teams, participating from the early stages of the development process and actively contributing to the quality of deliveries. We seek someone who understands that quality is not a final phase, but a continuous part of development.

What you'll do:

  • Act as an Agile QA, participating in team ceremonies (refinement, planning, daily, review, and retrospective).
  • Ensure delivery quality from the requirements-gathering phase (shift-left approach).
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated API tests.
  • Support the team in defining clear and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Execute functional, exploratory, and regression tests.
  • Log, track, and manage bugs in a clear, objective, and prioritized manner.
  • Work collaboratively with developers, product, and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s quality processes and practices.

What you'll need:

  • Experience with automated API testing (preferably Rest Assured + Kotlin).
  • Knowledge of BDD (Gherkin, Cucumber).
  • Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals.
  • Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum and/or Kanban).
  • Experience in bug management and use of tools such as Jira, Zephyr (or similar).
  • Ability to analyze requirements and identify quality risks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team.
  • Proactive, organized, and collaborative profile.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with E2E testing or frontend automation.
  • Basic knowledge of CI/CD and test execution in pipelines.
  • Basic knowledge of non-functional testing (performance, security, etc.).
  • Experience with log analysis and support in troubleshooting.
  • Experience testing in mobile or distributed environments.

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

A Beautycolor Company é uma empresa muito nacional ! Somos brasileiros e nascemos no estado do Paraná, mas nossa atuação é em todo o Brasil há muitos anos! Estamos entre as principais marcas de cosméticos do Brasil!! Nossa fábrica fica na cidade de Pinhais (região metropolitana de Curitiba) e temos equipes de Distribuição, Vendas e Merchandising em todos os estados.

Buscamos talentos que tenham:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com vendas no canal indireto (distribuidores e atacadistas);

  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel;

Benefícios que a Beautycolor Company oferece:

  • Convênio com Instituições de ensino;

Venha para a Beautycolor Company!
Temos muitos desafios e um time incrível te esperando!!

#ComVocêParaCrescer

Buscamos profissionais que tenham muita vontade de se desenvolver em um ambiente dinâmico e que oferece muitas oportunidades.

Assim como nós, esperamos que as pessoas possuam:

Interesse em atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras para mini mercados com autoatendimento.

  • Familiaridade com frameworks de frontend como Vue.js.
  • Familiaridade com Git e ferramentas de controle de versão.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos e gerenciamento de repositórios.

Híbrido

title: Expert Engineer in Verification (UVM/IP/SoC)
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.

What we offer you

  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Want to join us?

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

Assim, ocupamos um território próprio entre advisory, execução e investimento, com envolvimento direto nos projetos que conduzimos.

Para isso, combinamos uma atuação consultiva profunda a um processo de análise rigoroso, baseado em alto nível técnico e na construção de informações confiáveis, tanto para a empresa quanto para o investidor.

Acompanhamos poucas empresas por vez, com métricas claras, governança aplicada e alinhamento de interesses, participando ativamente da geração de valor ao longo da jornada.

Na Organismo, buscamos pessoas que queiram construir, executar e evoluir junto. Os projetos são complexos, o ritmo é intenso e o ambiente está em constante construção. Valorizamos profissionais que se sintam confortáveis em contextos dinâmicos, que gostem de desafios reais e tenham interesse genuíno em entender empresas por dentro e ajudá-las a evoluir.

Se você acredita que crescimento exige método, consistência e visão de longo prazo, e quer fazer parte de projetos que geram impacto real e sustentável, a Organismo pode ser o seu próximo passo.

Já pensou em trabalhar em uma multinacional de grande porte e impactar no que realmente importa? A Ecolab é o seu lugar! Nossa empresa desenvolve soluções e tecnologias para alimentos seguros, ambientes limpos, prevenção de infecções e economia de água aos nossos clientes em mais de 170 países!

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar conosco como Representante de Serviços em Campo II e fazer parte de nossa equipe.

A Ecolab acredita na inclusão e na promoção da diversidade em todas as suas formas. Temos como valor e premissa, o respeito e valorização das pessoas e combatemos qualquer tipo de discriminação. Ao fazer parte do nosso time, você poderá participar ativamente da construção da Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão na companhia e ser um aliado dos nossos Grupos de Afinidade, como o E3 (focado no desenvolvimento de mulheres), o Ecoessence (focado no desenvolvimento de pessoas negras), e do Pride (LGBTQIAP+).

  • Atuar com serviços técnicos nos equipamentos de tratamentos químicos nas instalações dos clientes assegurando a eficiência e funcionalidade deles;
  • Auxiliar as operações dos clientes e garantir que estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança, de modo a mensurar o resultado ao programa de soluções;
  • Realizar o controle de dosagem química nos produtos utilizados nas instalações dos clientes para assegurar que estejam dentro das variações estabelecidas;
  • Coletar amostras e realizar as análises físico-químicas reportando os resultados ao laboratório central e ao cliente;
  • Controlar estoque de produtos nas instalações do cliente para um fornecimento dentro do prazo acordado;
  • Detectar e reportar falhas e/ou problemas com produtos quando estiverem fora das variações estabelecidas, oferecendo alternativas rentáveis, conforme necessário;
  • Participar de reuniões com a equipe para promover melhorias em atendimento ao cliente;
  • Reportar serviços concluídos, fornecendo clareza e valor ao cliente;
  • Atendimento de serviços realizados via plataformas digitais e fechamentos das atividades são por ordem de serviços.

Quais são os requisitos para poder participar deste Processo Seletivo?

  • Formados no curso Técnico ou Superior em Química, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas (que possuam autorização para o profissional ter o CRQ);
  • Possuir certificação CRQ (apto ou com disponibilidade para ativar);
  • Profissionais com conhecimento em tratamento de águas de industriais em gerais;
  • Possui CNH B (para dirigir carro da empresa) com no mínimo 2 anos de emissão e que esteja ATIVA. (não podendo encontrar-se suspensa, recolhida ou qualquer outra condição que impossibilidade o Funcionário de utilizar veículo)
  • Você precisará ter disponibilidade para nas regiões de Campinas, Valinhos, Vinhedo, Jundiaí/SP ;
  • Flexibilidade de horário para viagens e para possíveis demandas pontuais;

O que fará seu perfil se destacar dos demais?

  • Ter experiência profissional em indústria de tratamento de águas;
  • Experiência no setor de químicos;
  • Conhecimentos em Pacote Office (Excel, Power Point e Outlook) e sistemas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento.

O que te oferecemos nessa jornada?

Salário competitivo, Auxílio Refeição, Carro Ferramenta, Convênio Médico e Odontológico, Gympass, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, PLR, Programa de Treinamentos Internos, Programa de Desenvolvimento e Trilha de Carreira, entre outros

Um parceiro de confiança para quase três milhões de clientes, a Ecolab é líder global em sustentabilidade, oferecendo soluções e serviços para água, higiene e prevenção de infecções, que protegem as pessoas e os recursos vitais. Com mais de um século de inovação, a Ecolab apresenta vendas anuais de US$ 14 bilhões e 47.000 funcionários, operando em mais de 170 países em todo o mundo. A empresa oferece soluções abrangentes, baseadas na ciência, conhecimentos específicos e serviços de classe mundial para promover a segurança dos alimentos, manter os ambientes limpos e seguros e otimizar o uso da água e energia. As soluções inovadoras da Ecolab melhoram a eficiência operacional e a sustentabilidade de clientes nos setores de alimentos, industrial, saúde e hospitalidade.

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.
  • Building and managing product roadmaps, aligning them with strategic goals while balancing stakeholder priorities.
  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user‑centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.
  • Using data and metrics to drive decision‑making, develop business cases, and measure success.
  • Writing detailed business requirements and user stories for clear communication with the development team.
  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.
  • Monitoring and communicating product performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing solutions.
  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You’ll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium‑to‑large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a customer‑centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem‑solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high‑quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user‑centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.

Quality Assurance Engineer (QA) with TypeScript and Node.js

Position Overview

As a Quality Assurance Engineer at The Methodical Group, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and usability of our applications built on TypeScript and Node.js foundations. Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven experience in quality assurance/testing of web applications, preferably using TypeScript and Node.js technologies.
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Proficiency in test automation using testing frameworks/tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.

Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Qual a missão do Cargo?

Garantir a qualidade técnica e funcional das entregas do produto, atuando de forma colaborativa com o time de desenvolvimento para promover práticas de automação, prevenção de defeitos e melhoria contínua. O desafio principal é garantir entregas seguras, estáveis e com alto padrão de qualidade, contribuindo para a maturidade dos processos de teste e observabilidade.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Atuar no planejamento, execução e automação de testes funcionais, regressivos e exploratórios.
  • Validar integrações entre APIs e microsserviços, garantindo cobertura e rastreabilidade dos testes.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação (backend) integrados ao pipeline CI/CD.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na identificação e prevenção de defeitos desde as etapas iniciais.
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e discussões técnicas voltadas à qualidade e desempenho.
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz para falhas recorrentes e propor soluções de melhoria.
  • Apoiar a evolução de métricas de qualidade e observabilidade (defeitos, cobertura, tempo de execução).
  • Colaborar com o time na priorização e definição de critérios de aceite.
  • Disseminar boas práticas de qualidade e testes automatizados entre os colegas do time.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência em automação de testes de API (Postman, RestAssured ou similares).
  • Experiência em automação de testes utilizando as linguagens Python, Java ou Javascript.
  • Experiência em elaboração e execução de Testes Funcionais, Testes Não-Funcionais (testes de performance e usabilidade).
  • Níveis de teste: Testes Unitários, Testes Integração/Serviço, Testes de Sistema.
  • Técnicas de teste: Caixa branca, Caixa preta, Exploratórios.
  • Conhecimento em automação de testes web (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright ou equivalentes). Vivência com pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, Bitbucket).
  • Experiência em análise de logs, troubleshooting e monitoramento de aplicações.
  • Domínio em versionamento (Git) e boas práticas de testes em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados SQL e NoSQL para validação de dados.
  • Capacidade de escrever cenários de teste com clareza e alinhamento aos critérios de aceite.

Quais serão os requisitos diferenciais para este cargo?

  • Experiência com produtos regulatórios.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Experiência em testes de performance (JMeter, k6) e segurança (OWASP).
  • Contribuições em comunidades técnicas, QA Guilds ou projetos open source.
  • Atuação prévia com frameworks de BDD (Cucumber, Behave).
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas kubernetes, docker.

title: Digital Talent | Bosch Global
description:
How Bosch is training the smartest minds

In the race to secure the best digital talent, Bosch is setting up the “Digital Talent Academy” in Brazil. It trains young people in areas such as software development and artificial intelligence. For many of them, this represents a decisive step toward a different life.

The red logotype is already recognizable from the freeway. Huge letters spelling out BOSCH adorn the main building of the Campinas location in Brazil. Nicolly Cristina Cruz Storoni had often driven past here with her mother. She had never imagined that she could ever work for the company with the red logo. But two years ago, her dream unexpectedly became reality. In July 2021, the then 17-year-old applied for a place at Bosch’s newly established Digital Talent Academy (DTA) in Campinas and prevailed over more than 2,000 candidates. She was among the top 18 who were offered a place in that year’s round of admissions.

Since summer 2021, Nicolly has been studying and working at the Digital Talent Academy at the Bosch location in Campinas, Brazil

My biggest wish is to finish my apprenticeship, buy my own apartment and car, and develop professionally in my career.

YouTube

Loading the video requires your consent. If you agree by clicking on the Play icon, the video will load and data will be transmitted to Google as well as information will be accessed and stored by Google on your device. Google may be able to link these data or information with existing data.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”

Isso mesmo, o Hub de Tecnologia da Ambev!

Somos responsáveis por impulsionar a transformação digital da Ambev.
